snippet.title: Five Faizul Fridays DX Trailer
snippet.description:
Five Faizul Fridays DX
Coming 26/01/2026
https://ebjb.itch.io/five-faizul-fridays-dx

Join our Discord server for future updates and announcements: ETSHqf4k6v 


In a run-down high school led by a deranged computer science professor, Dr. F, you must survive twenty-five days until the final exam. 

Plot with your fellow clan members, complete Dr. F's tasks, and sabotage rival clan members for freedom. Respect isn't given, it's earned by fighting, vandalising, cannibalising your enemies, whatever it takes to prove you're not to be messed with.

Freedom is the ultimate goal, but only a few will make it out alive.
